i still pay close attention to lower timeframes when i expect major liquidations or a significant market turning point, but outside of those moments, i'm comfortable moving slower

trading is something you can keep improving at for decades, and part of that process is learning when your attention actually matters

more hours staring at charts doesn't necessarily mean better trades
